author: Upsoar
body:
Battle For The Seas:
 - 3 monuments for each team (Bow, Starboard, Stern)
 - Maximum of 25 players per team
 - Teams are Redbeard (Red) and Bluehook (Blue)
 - Map contains gold, iron and diamond
 - Equipment (In order)
    ~ Stone Sword
    ~ Bow (Infinity)
    ~ Diamond Pickaxe
    ~ Golden Apples (3)
    ~ Oak Wood (16)
    ~ Stone (64)
    ~ Glass (64)
    ~ Cooked Steak (10)
    ~ Full Leather Armor
Map Download: https://www.dropbox.com/s/mvqgz6bsf2w2184/Battle%20For%20The%20Seas.zip?dl=0
YML: http://pastebin.com/cHd5Ljvz (YML By Merlinmaster) <--YML Broken 7/2/2014
Images: http://imgur.com/a/VsjMA New Images : http://imgur.com/a/ficwB#0
